ontology_goal: To provide a structured representation of aviation emergency procedures, enabling effective querying and retrieval of information related to emergency landings, pilot actions, and associated hazards.
modeling_principles: Explicitly model procedures, events, actions, warnings, hazards, aircraft state, source evidence, flight phase, and step type.
Preserve provenance and source evidence as a core requirement.
Separate immediate actions from training notes, cautions, and background information.
Ensure the ontology is implementable as LinkML/SHACL/RDF.

classes.name: EmergencyProcedure
classes.definition: A structured set of actions to be taken during an aviation emergency.
responsibilities: Define the sequence of actions for emergencies.

classes.name: ProcedureStep
classes.definition: An individual step within an emergency procedure, detailing specific actions to be taken.
responsibilities: Outline specific actions within a procedure.
Maintain order and context for each step.

classes.name: Warning
classes.definition: A notification regarding potential hazards or risks during flight operations.

classes.name: SourceEvidence
classes.definition: Documentation or data that supports the procedures and actions taken during emergencies.

classes.name: TriggerCondition
classes.definition: Conditions that necessitate the execution of an emergency procedure.

classes.name: FlightPhase
classes.definition: Different stages of flight that may influence emergency procedures.
responsibilities: Categorize actions based on flight stages.

classes.name: Hazard
classes.definition: Potential risks that may affect flight safety during emergencies.

classes.name: AircraftState
classes.definition: The operational status of the aircraft during an emergency.

classes.name: AircraftSystem
classes.definition: Components of the aircraft that may be affected during emergencies.
responsibilities: Detail systems relevant to emergency procedures.

classes.name: EmergencyEvent
classes.definition: An occurrence that triggers the need for emergency procedures.

classes.name: PilotAction
classes.definition: Actions taken by the pilot in response to emergency situations.
responsibilities: Link actions to procedures and conditions.

object_properties.name: has_step
object_properties.definition: Links an emergency procedure to its individual steps.

object_properties.name: triggers
object_properties.definition: Indicates which emergency procedure is triggered by a specific condition.

object_properties.name: associated_with
object_properties.definition: Links hazards to relevant emergency procedures.

object_properties.name: evidenced_by
object_properties.definition: Links an emergency procedure to its supporting evidence.

object_properties.name: occurs_during
object_properties.definition: Indicates the flight phase during which an emergency event occurs.

object_properties.name: performed_by
object_properties.definition: Links pilot actions to specific emergency events.

object_properties.name: affects
object_properties.definition: Indicates how the aircraft state influences the execution of emergency procedures.

object_properties.name: requires
object_properties.definition: Indicates the conditions that must be met to execute a procedure.

object_properties.name: influences
object_properties.definition: Indicates how psychological factors affect pilot actions.

data_properties.name: step_order
data_properties.definition: The order in which the step should be executed within a procedure.

data_properties.name: action_text
data_properties.definition: Text describing the action to be taken in this step.

data_properties.name: step_type
data_properties.definition: The type of step (e.g., action, caution, note).

data_properties.name: hazard_description
data_properties.definition: A description of the hazard associated with the procedure.

data_properties.name: evidence_source
data_properties.definition: The source from which the evidence is derived.

data_properties.name: event_description
data_properties.definition: A description of the emergency event.

data_properties.name: pilot_decision
data_properties.definition: The decision made by the pilot in response to the emergency.

data_properties.name: flight_phase_name
data_properties.definition: The name of the flight phase.

data_properties.name: aircraft_condition
data_properties.definition: The condition of the aircraft during the emergency.

data_properties.name: system_name
data_properties.definition: The name of the aircraft system being referenced.

validation_rules.rule: Each ProcedureStep must have a unique step_order within its EmergencyProcedure.
An EmergencyProcedure must have at least one ProcedureStep.
Each Hazard must be linked to at least one EmergencyProcedure.

implementation_notes: The ontology is designed to be compact and focused on core classes and properties relevant to aviation emergencies. It supports effective querying and retrieval of information while ensuring compliance with provenance requirements.
